title: A Temporal Network Approach to Paranoia: A Pilot Study
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Small sample size (n=23); - Low ESM compliance leading to missing data; - Data not meeting normality assumptions; - Low-dimensional network (5 nodes); - No formal test for centrality; - No tools available to test robustness of temporal networks.
notes: The study was not preregistered. The code and data are available on OSF (https://osf.io/7tk4b/). The authors state that the data were collected as part of a larger RCT, but no preregistration link was found. The study is a pilot study with a small sample size.
